title: 微影晶圓台精密定位
titleEn: Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages
summary: 以步進掃描微影機的雙台晶圓台為對象：先建立光罩台與晶圓台 4:1 同步掃描的 MA/MSD 誤差定義與 Abbe 原理，再拆解長短行程 Lorentz 致動器與平衡質量、雷射干涉儀與二維光柵編碼器的解析度與空氣折射率限制，接著以伺服頻寬、前饋精度、校正圖與隔振傳遞率建立奈米級誤差預算，最後整合成產能與套刻驗收記錄。
summaryEn: Taking the dual wafer stage of a step-and-scan lithography system as the object, the course first defines the MA/MSD errors of 4:1 synchronised reticle and wafer scanning and the Abbe principle, then dissects long- and short-stroke Lorentz actuators with balance masses, the resolution and air-index limits of laser interferometers and two-dimensional grating encoders, builds a nanometre error budget from servo bandwidth, feedforward accuracy, calibration maps and isolation transmissibility, and closes with a throughput and overlay acceptance record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 掃描與誤差預算練習：晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s、光罩台 2.0 m/s、加速度 20 m/s²。加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 6.25 mm；掃描 33 mm 場加 8 mm 縫隙共 41 mm 需 82 ms；每點在縫隙下 16 ms。伺服交越 300 Hz 時 ω_c = 1885 rad/s，無前饋的加速度追蹤誤差 a/ω_c² = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm，前饋精度 99.9% 後剩 5.6 nm，這是 MA 的一個主要項。量測側：干涉儀死程 300 mm、10 mK 溫度變化給 2.8 nm，改用 3 mm 氣隙的光柵編碼器後為 0.028 nm。MA 預算取編碼器殘差 0.4、Abbe 0.3、伺服 0.5、熱 0.4、光柵 0.3 nm，RSS ≈ 0.87 nm；若保留干涉儀的 2.8 nm 空氣項，RSS 變成 √(0.75 + 7.84) ≈ 2.9 nm，超過 1.5 nm 的套刻分配，這就是光柵編碼器取代長光程干涉儀的工程理由。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Scan and error-budget exercise: wafer scan speed 0.5 m/s, reticle stage 2.0 m/s, acceleration 20 m/s². Reaching 0.5 m/s takes 25 ms and 6.25 mm; the 33 mm field plus 8 mm slit, 41 mm in all, takes 82 ms; each point sits under the slit for 16 ms. With a 300 Hz servo crossover, ω_c = 1885 rad/s, the acceleration tracking error without feedforward is a/ω_c² = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm, and 99.9% feedforward accuracy leaves 5.6 nm, a major MA item. On the measurement side, a 300 mm interferometer dead path with a 10 mK change gives 2.8 nm, whereas a grating encoder with a 3 mm air gap gives 0.028 nm. The MA budget with encoder residual 0.4, Abbe 0.3, servo 0.5, thermal 0.4 and grating 0.3 nm gives RSS ≈ 0.87 nm; keeping the interferometer's 2.8 nm air term instead raises the RSS to √(0.75 + 7.84) ≈ 2.9 nm, beyond a 1.5 nm overlay allocation, which is the engineering reason grating encoders replaced long-path interferometers. All numbers are teaching assumptions.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「步進掃描的同步誤差定義」與「Abbe 原理與計量框架」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 步進掃描機以一條約 26 mm 寬、數毫米高的照明縫隙掃過光罩，光罩台與晶圓台必須以 4:1 的速度比反向同步運動，掃完一個 26×33 mm 的場後晶圓台步進到下一場。晶圓上任一點在縫隙通過期間累積曝光，所以位置誤差的影響分成兩類：這段時間的平均誤差（MA）直接變成套刻誤差，而誤差的移動標準差（MSD）讓影像模糊、降低對比與 CD 均勻性。因此規格不是單一的定位精度，而是對掃描時間窗平均後的 MA 與 MSD。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A step-and-scan system sweeps an illumination slit roughly 26 mm wide and a few millimetres high across the reticle while the reticle stage and wafer stage move in opposite directions at a 4:1 speed ratio, and after each 26×33 mm field the wafer stage steps to the next one. Any wafer point accumulates exposure while the slit passes, so position error acts in two ways: its average over that window (MA) becomes overlay error, while its moving standard deviation (MSD) blurs the image and degrades contrast and CD uniformity. The specification is therefore not a single positioning accuracy but MA and MSD averaged over the scan time window. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s 時光罩台為 2.0 m/s；掃描長度 33 mm 加縫隙高 8 mm 共 41 mm，需時 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms；以 20 m/s² 加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm 的助跑距離；晶圓上每一點在 8 mm 縫隙下停留 16 ms，MA 與 MSD 就是在這 16 ms 窗口內計算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s the reticle stage runs at 2.0 m/s; the 33 mm scan plus an 8 mm slit height is 41 mm and takes 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms; accelerating to 0.5 m/s at 20 m/s² takes 25 ms and a run-up distance of v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm; every wafer point sits under the 8 mm slit for 16 ms, and MA and MSD are computed over that 16 ms window.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「晶圓台的靜態定位精度就等於套刻精度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The static positioning accuracy of the stage equals the overlay accuracy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s 時光罩台為 2.0 m/s；掃描長度 33 mm 加縫隙高 8 mm 共 41 mm，需時 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms；以 20 m/s² 加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm 的助跑距離；晶圓上每一點在 8 mm 縫隙下停留 16 ms，MA 與 MSD 就是在這 16 ms 窗口內計算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s the reticle stage runs at 2.0 m/s; the 33 mm scan plus an 8 mm slit height is 41 mm and takes 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms; accelerating to 0.5 m/s at 20 m/s² takes 25 ms and a run-up distance of v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm; every wafer point sits under the 8 mm slit for 16 ms, and MA and MSD are computed over that 16 ms window. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從伺服系統以取樣率數十 kHz 記錄光罩台與晶圓台的位置誤差，先換算成晶圓座標（光罩誤差除以 4），對 16 ms 的滑動窗口計算 MA 與 MSD，沿掃描方向畫成曲線，再與曝光後的套刻與 CD 量測對應，確認兩者的空間分佈一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log reticle- and wafer-stage position errors from the servo at tens of kHz, convert them to wafer coordinates (reticle error divided by 4), compute MA and MSD over a sliding 16 ms window, plot them along the scan direction and correlate with post-exposure overlay and CD measurements to confirm matching spatial patterns.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 從伺服系統以取樣率數十 kHz 記錄光罩台與晶圓台的位置誤差，先換算成晶圓座標（光罩誤差除以 4），對 16 ms 的滑動窗口計算 MA 與 MSD，沿掃描方向畫成曲線，再與曝光後的套刻與 CD 量測對應，確認兩者的空間分佈一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log reticle- and wafer-stage position errors from the servo at tens of kHz, convert them to wafer coordinates (reticle error divided by 4), compute MA and MSD over a sliding 16 ms window, plot them along the scan direction and correlate with post-exposure overlay and CD measurements to confirm matching spatial patterns. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：掃描方向的加速段若未完全穩定就進入曝光，場的起始端會留下系統性的 MA 偏移與較高的 MSD，表現為每個場上緣的套刻偏差與線寬粗糙，而靜態定位測試完全看不出來。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If exposure starts before the acceleration phase has fully settled, the leading edge of every field carries a systematic MA offset and elevated MSD, seen as overlay deviation and rougher linewidth along one field edge, something a static positioning test never reveals.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: Abbe 原理與計量框架：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Metrology frame and Abbe offset” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Abbe 原理要求量測軸與被量測點共線，否則載台的微小旋轉會乘上偏置距離變成位置誤差。晶圓表面與干涉儀光束或編碼器讀頭之間總有數毫米的垂直偏置，所以晶圓台必須同時量測六個自由度，用俯仰與偏擺角把 Abbe 誤差算回去。所有量測都參照一個由 Zerodur 或碳化矽製成、與機架隔振的計量框架，投影鏡頭與感測器固定其上，使位置量測的參考零點與影像位置共用同一剛體。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Abbe principle demands that the measurement axis pass through the point of interest, otherwise a tiny stage rotation multiplied by the offset distance becomes a position error. There is always a vertical offset of several millimetres between the wafer surface and the interferometer beams or encoder heads, so the wafer stage must be measured in all six degrees of freedom and the pitch and yaw angles used to compute the Abbe error back out. Every measurement refers to a metrology frame made of Zerodur or silicon carbide and isolated from the base frame; the projection lens and sensors are mounted on it so the position reference and the image share one rigid body. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Metrology frame and Abbe offset”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Abbe 誤差 = 偏置 × 旋轉角：偏置 5 mm、載台俯仰 0.2 µrad 時誤差 = 5×10⁻³×0.2×10⁻⁶ = 1 nm；若角度量測解析度為 0.05 µrad，殘餘 Abbe 誤差可壓到 0.25 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Abbe error = offset × rotation: with a 5 mm offset and 0.2 µrad of stage pitch the error is 5×10⁻³×0.2×10⁻⁶ = 1 nm; with an angular measurement resolution of 0.05 µrad the residual Abbe error falls to 0.25 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要載台導軌夠直，旋轉誤差就可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 晶圓台採雙層結構：長行程台以線性或平面馬達在整片晶圓範圍移動，精度在微米級；短行程台以六組 Lorentz 致動器相對長行程台做毫米級行程的六自由度微動，達到奈米級。Lorentz 致動器力與電流成正比且無接觸、無磁滯，重力由永磁補償器承擔以減少發熱。加速時的反作用力若傳到機架會激發振動，所以馬達定子裝在可自由滑動的平衡質量上，動量守恆讓反作用力留在平衡質量而不進入計量框架。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Lorentz 致動器與平衡質量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 干涉儀解析度、空氣折射率與光柵量測：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Interferometer resolution, air index and grating metrology: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雷射干涉儀與光柵編碼器」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Laser interferometer and grating encoder” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 傳統晶圓台以 HeNe 雷射外差干涉儀量測位置：平面鏡雙程架構使每條干涉條紋對應四分之一波長，再由相位內插得到次奈米解析度。它的弱點是光束在空氣中走過數百毫米，空氣折射率隨溫度、壓力與濕度變化，死程誤差與擾流成為主要誤差源。近代機台改用固定在計量框架下方的二維光柵板與載台上的編碼器讀頭，空氣光程縮短到毫米級，對環境的靈敏度下降兩個數量級，代價是光柵板本身的圖樣誤差必須被校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射干涉儀與光柵編碼器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Conventional wafer stages are measured with HeNe heterodyne laser interferometers: a double-pass plane-mirror configuration makes each fringe correspond to a quarter wavelength, and phase interpolation yields sub-nanometre resolution. Their weakness is the beam path of several hundred millimetres through air, whose refractive index varies with temperature, pressure and humidity, so dead-path error and turbulence dominate. Modern systems instead use two-dimensional grating plates fixed under the metrology frame with encoder heads on the stage, shrinking the air path to millimetres and cutting environmental sensitivity by two orders of magnitude, at the cost of having to calibrate the grating pattern itself. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser interferometer and grating encoder”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：HeNe λ = 632.8 nm 雙程干涉儀每條紋 λ/4 = 158.2 nm，4096 倍相位內插得 0.039 nm 解析度；但空氣 dn/dT ≈ −0.93×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹，死程 300 mm 遇到 10 mK 溫度變化就產生 0.3×0.93×10⁻⁶×0.01 ≈ 2.8 nm 誤差。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A HeNe λ = 632.8 nm double-pass interferometer has λ/4 = 158.2 nm per fringe and 4096-fold phase interpolation gives 0.039 nm resolution; but air has dn/dT ≈ −0.93×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹, so a 300 mm dead path with a 10 mK temperature change produces 0.3×0.93×10⁻⁶×0.01 ≈ 2.8 nm of error.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「干涉儀的解析度 0.04 nm 就是它的量測精度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An interferometer with 0.04 nm resolution measures with 0.04 nm accuracy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雷射干涉儀與光柵編碼器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：HeNe λ = 632.8 nm 雙程干涉儀每條紋 λ/4 = 158.2 nm，4096 倍相位內插得 0.039 nm 解析度；但空氣 dn/dT ≈ −0.93×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹，死程 300 mm 遇到 10 mK 溫度變化就產生 0.3×0.93×10⁻⁶×0.01 ≈ 2.8 nm 誤差。光柵編碼器的空氣間隙約 3 mm，同樣 10 mK 只造成 0.028 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A HeNe λ = 632.8 nm double-pass interferometer has λ/4 = 158.2 nm per fringe and 4096-fold phase interpolation gives 0.039 nm resolution; but air has dn/dT ≈ −0.93×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹, so a 300 mm dead path with a 10 mK temperature change produces 0.3×0.93×10⁻⁶×0.01 ≈ 2.8 nm of error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Hold the stage still and log the interferometer or encoder reading for several minutes, compute the Allan deviation versus averaging time to separate white noise, air turbulence and thermal drift; log temperature and pressure simultaneously, apply the Edlén correction and check that the residual falls to the expected level.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 干涉儀解析度、空氣折射率與光柵量測：量測與驗證

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.instruction: 載台位置迴路通常用 PID 加上陷波濾波器，交越頻率在數百赫茲；更高的頻寬會被載台本體的第一個結構共振限制，經驗上共振頻率要高於頻寬的三到五倍，因此載台用碳化矽或陶瓷等高比剛度材料。掃描時的追蹤誤差主要不是靠回授壓低，而是用加速度前饋：把參考軌跡的加速度乘上質量直接送到致動器，回授只處理前饋的殘差與擾動。前饋的質量與延遲若估錯，殘差就直接以加速度為比例出現。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「伺服迴路與前饋控制」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：雙積分受控體在恆定加速度下的穩態誤差 e ≈ a/ω_c²：a = 20 m/s²、交越頻率 300 Hz（ω_c = 1885 rad/s）時 e = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm；若前饋把 99.9% 的加速力提供出來，剩餘誤差為 5.6 nm。頻寬 300 Hz 要求第一共振高於約 1.5 kHz；整定時間常數 1/ω_c ≈ 0.53 ms，從 1 µm 收斂到 1 nm 需 ln(1000)×0.53 ≈ 3.7 ms。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A double-integrator plant under constant acceleration has steady-state error e ≈ a/ω_c²: with a = 20 m/s² and a 300 Hz crossover (ω_c = 1885 rad/s), e = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm; if feedforward supplies 99.9% of the acceleration force, the remaining error is 5.6 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測開迴路頻率響應（Bode 圖）確認增益交越、相位餘裕與共振位置；執行標準掃描軌跡並記錄誤差，分別關閉與開啟前饋比較誤差量級，再微調前饋質量與延遲參數直到加速段的殘差不再與加速度成比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the open-loop frequency response (Bode plot) to confirm gain crossover, phase margin and resonance locations; run the standard scan trajectory and log the error with feedforward off and on to compare magnitudes, then tune the feedforward mass and delay until the residual during acceleration no longer scales with acceleration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Calibration maps and error-budget table” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量測系統本身有系統性誤差：干涉儀反射鏡的平面度、光柵板的圖樣誤差、讀頭之間的非正交性與比例誤差，都要用自校正或交叉比對建成校正圖並在控制器中即時扣除。MA 誤差直接進入套刻預算，而 MSD 則像高斯模糊降低影像對比，對小間距的影響最大。誤差預算表把量測、致動、熱與振動的各項以均方根合成，並區分可校正的系統項與不可校正的隨機項。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「校正圖與誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：MSD = 3 nm 對週期 80 nm 線條的對比因子為 exp(−2π²σ²/p²) = exp(−2π²×9/6400) ≈ 0.973，即損失 2.7%。MA 預算：編碼器校正殘差 0.4 nm、Abbe 補償殘差 0.3 nm、伺服 MA 0.5 nm、熱漂移 0.4 nm、光柵圖樣殘差 0.3 nm，RSS = √(0.16+0.09+0.25+0.16+0.09) = √0.75 ≈ 0.87 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align repeatedly on a reference mark array at different stage positions and rotations, separate stage error from mark error with a self-calibration algorithm and update the calibration maps; then expose test wafers and compare the systematic overlay residual with the sum of the budget items, confirming that unmodelled contributions stay below 20% of the budget.

steps.title: 隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「主動隔振與地面振動」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Active isolation and floor vibration” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 計量框架與投影鏡頭由三到四組氣浮或電磁隔振器支撐，形成約 1 Hz 的低頻彈簧質量系統，地面振動在遠高於共振的頻率被衰減；主動隔振再以加速度計回授增加阻尼並壓低共振峰，同時以載台反作用力與重心移動的前饋抵消可預測的擾動。晶圓廠地板的振動等級、幫浦與空調的窄頻擾動、以及載台本身的動量轉移，都必須納入整機振動預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主動隔振與地面振動」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The metrology frame and projection lens rest on three or four pneumatic or electromagnetic isolators forming a spring-mass system near 1 Hz, so floor vibration well above that resonance is attenuated; active isolation adds accelerometer feedback for damping and resonance suppression, plus feedforward to cancel predictable disturbances from stage reaction forces and centre-of-gravity shifts. The fab floor vibration class, narrowband disturbances from pumps and air handling, and momentum transfer from the stages themselves all enter the whole-tool vibration budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active isolation and floor vibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：無阻尼隔振器的傳遞率 T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1)：f_n = 1 Hz 時，10 Hz 的傳遞率約 1/99 ≈ 0.010。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An undamped isolator has transmissibility T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1): with f_n = 1 Hz the transmissibility at 10 Hz is about 1/99 ≈ 0.010.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔振器把所有頻率的振動都衰減。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Isolators attenuate vibration at every frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「主動隔振與地面振動」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Active isolation and floor vibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主動隔振與地面振動」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Active isolation and floor vibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：無阻尼隔振器的傳遞率 T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1)：f_n = 1 Hz 時，10 Hz 的傳遞率約 1/99 ≈ 0.010。若地板在 10 Hz 的振動速度為 3 µm/s，位移振幅 = v/(2πf) = 3×10⁻⁶/62.8 ≈ 48 nm，經隔振後計量框架只動 0.48 nm；但在 1.5 Hz 附近傳遞率反而放大到 1/(2.25 − 1) = 0.8，必須靠主動阻尼壓低。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An undamped isolator has transmissibility T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1): with f_n = 1 Hz the transmissibility at 10 Hz is about 1/99 ≈ 0.010. If the floor vibrates at 3 µm/s at 10 Hz, the displacement amplitude is v/(2πf) = 3×10⁻⁶/62.8 ≈ 48 nm, and the metrology frame moves only 0.48 nm after isolation; near 1.5 Hz, however, transmissibility rises to 1/(2.25 − 1) = 0.8 and must be suppressed by active damping. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在地板與計量框架同時裝加速度計，量測傳遞率頻譜並與模型比較；再執行完整的掃描與步進循環，記錄框架振動與載台 MSD 的相關性，確認載台反作用力前饋能把共振附近的放大壓到預算內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mount accelerometers on both floor and metrology frame, measure the transmissibility spectrum and compare with the model; then run full scan-and-step cycles, record the correlation between frame vibration and stage MSD, and confirm that reaction-force feedforward keeps amplification near resonance within budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration", which statement holds?

干涉儀的解析度 0.04 nm 就是它的量測精度。
無阻尼隔振器的傳遞率 T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1)：f_n = 1 Hz 時，10 Hz 的傳遞率約 1/99 ≈ 0.010。

An interferometer with 0.04 nm resolution measures with 0.04 nm accuracy.

steps.title: 隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「主動隔振與地面振動」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Active isolation and floor vibration” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在地板與計量框架同時裝加速度計，量測傳遞率頻譜並與模型比較；再執行完整的掃描與步進循環，記錄框架振動與載台 MSD 的相關性，確認載台反作用力前饋能把共振附近的放大壓到預算內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mount accelerometers on both floor and metrology frame, measure the transmissibility spectrum and compare with the model; then run full scan-and-step cycles, record the correlation between frame vibration and stage MSD, and confirm that reaction-force feedforward keeps amplification near resonance within budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：廠務新增的真空幫浦在 25 Hz 產生窄頻振動，雖然傳遞率只有 0.0016，但若剛好接近載台某個模態，MSD 會在該頻率出現尖峰，整批晶圓的 CD 均勻性下降而找不到機台內部原因。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A newly installed facility vacuum pump produces narrowband vibration at 25 Hz; although transmissibility is only 0.0016, if it lands near a stage mode the MSD spikes at that frequency and CD uniformity drops across whole lots with no internal cause to be found.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在地板與計量框架同時裝加速度計，量測傳遞率頻譜並與模型比較；再執行完整的掃描與步進循環，記錄框架振動與載台 MSD 的相關性，確認載台反作用力前饋能把共振附近的放大壓到預算內。
knowledge.textEn: Mount accelerometers on both floor and metrology frame, measure the transmissibility spectrum and compare with the model; then run full scan-and-step cycles, record the correlation between frame vibration and stage MSD, and confirm that reaction-force feedforward keeps amplification near resonance within budget.

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。

quiz.question: 要驗證「隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計：失效診斷

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.objective: 說明「產能模型與套刻驗收記錄」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Throughput model and overlay acceptance record” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 載台的工程價值最後以兩個數字體現：每小時晶圓數與套刻。產能由每場的掃描時間、步進時間、整定時間與晶圓交換時間決定，雙台架構讓對準與高度量測在另一台上同時進行，把量測時間隱藏在曝光之後。驗收用同一片晶圓重複曝光量機台對自身套刻，用不同機台曝光量機台間套刻；交接文件包括校正圖版本、MA/MSD 基準曲線、熱穩定時間與所有感測器的校正日期。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「產能模型與套刻驗收記錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The stage's engineering value is finally expressed in two numbers: wafers per hour and overlay. Throughput follows from scan time, step time, settling time and wafer exchange per field, and the dual-stage architecture lets alignment and height mapping run on the other stage so that measurement time hides behind exposure. Acceptance measures machine-to-itself overlay by re-exposing the same wafer and machine-to-machine overlay across tools; the handoff record includes calibration-map versions, MA/MSD baseline curves, thermal stabilisation time and the calibration dates of every sensor. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Throughput model and overlay acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每場掃描 82 ms 加步進與整定 50 ms 共 132 ms，96 個場需 12.7 s；晶圓交換與未被隱藏的開銷取 8 s，每片 20.7 s，產能 3600/20.7 ≈ 174 片/小時。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Each field takes 82 ms of scan plus 50 ms of step and settle, 132 ms in all, so 96 fields need 12.7 s; with 8 s of wafer exchange and unhidden overhead the wafer takes 20.7 s, giving 3600/20.7 ≈ 174 wafers per hour.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「套刻合格的機台，產能設定可以任意提高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tool that passes overlay can have its throughput settings raised freely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「產能模型與套刻驗收記錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Throughput model and overlay acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 載台的工程價值最後以兩個數字體現：每小時晶圓數與套刻。產能由每場的掃描時間、步進時間、整定時間與晶圓交換時間決定，雙台架構讓對準與高度量測在另一台上同時進行，把量測時間隱藏在曝光之後。

Throughput follows from scan time, step time, settling time and wafer exchange per field, and the dual-stage architecture lets alignment and height mapping run on the other stage so that measurement time hides behind exposure.

knowledge.text: 誤解：套刻合格的機台，產能設定可以任意提高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A tool that passes overlay can have its throughput settings raised freely. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

steps.title: 載台產能、整機驗收與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stage throughput, system acceptance and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「產能模型與套刻驗收記錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Throughput model and overlay acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每場掃描 82 ms 加步進與整定 50 ms 共 132 ms，96 個場需 12.7 s；晶圓交換與未被隱藏的開銷取 8 s，每片 20.7 s，產能 3600/20.7 ≈ 174 片/小時。若整定時間因共振問題多出 20 ms，每片多 1.9 s，產能降到 159 片/小時，下降 8.6%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Each field takes 82 ms of scan plus 50 ms of step and settle, 132 ms in all, so 96 fields need 12.7 s; with 8 s of wafer exchange and unhidden overhead the wafer takes 20.7 s, giving 3600/20.7 ≈ 174 wafers per hour. If a resonance problem adds 20 ms of settling per field, each wafer takes 1.9 s longer and throughput falls to 159 wafers per hour, a drop of 8.6%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用機台時間戳記錄每一場的掃描、步進、整定與交換時間，與模型逐項比較找出產能損失來源；對同一片晶圓做兩次曝光量測套刻，取 |mean| + 3σ 與規格比較；核對交接文件中的校正圖版本與感測器校正日期是否與機台實際狀態一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log the scan, step, settle and exchange time of every field from machine timestamps and compare with the model item by item to locate throughput loss; expose the same wafer twice, measure overlay as |mean| + 3σ and compare with specification; check that the calibration-map versions and sensor calibration dates in the handoff record match the tool's actual state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 每場掃描 82 ms 加步進與整定 50 ms 共 132 ms，96 個場需 12.7 s；晶圓交換與未被隱藏的開銷取 8 s，每片 20.7 s，產能 3600/20.7 ≈ 174 片/小時。若整定時間因共振問題多出 20 ms，每片多 1.9 s，產能降到 159 片/小時，下降 8.6%。

If a resonance problem adds 20 ms of settling per field, each wafer takes 1.9 s longer and throughput falls to 159 wafers per hour, a drop of 8.6%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 載台產能、整機驗收與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stage throughput, system acceptance and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「產能模型與套刻驗收記錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Throughput model and overlay acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用機台時間戳記錄每一場的掃描、步進、整定與交換時間，與模型逐項比較找出產能損失來源；對同一片晶圓做兩次曝光量測套刻，取 |mean| + 3σ 與規格比較；核對交接文件中的校正圖版本與感測器校正日期是否與機台實際狀態一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log the scan, step, settle and exchange time of every field from machine timestamps and compare with the model item by item to locate throughput loss; expose the same wafer twice, measure overlay as |mean| + 3σ and compare with specification; check that the calibration-map versions and sensor calibration dates in the handoff record match the tool's actual state. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了衝產能縮短整定時間，MA 看似仍在規格內，但 MSD 在每場起始端悄悄升高，CD 均勻性與良率在數週後才在電性測試中暴露，追查時已無當時的載台誤差紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Cutting settling time to chase throughput leaves MA apparently within specification while MSD creeps up at the start of every field; CD uniformity and yield only surface weeks later in electrical test, by which time the stage error logs of that period are gone.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用機台時間戳記錄每一場的掃描、步進、整定與交換時間，與模型逐項比較找出產能損失來源；對同一片晶圓做兩次曝光量測套刻，取 |mean| + 3σ 與規格比較；核對交接文件中的校正圖版本與感測器校正日期是否與機台實際狀態一致。
knowledge.textEn: Log the scan, step, settle and exchange time of every field from machine timestamps and compare with the model item by item to locate throughput loss; expose the same wafer twice, measure overlay as |mean| + 3σ and compare with specification; check that the calibration-map versions and sensor calibration dates in the handoff record match the tool's actual state.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「載台產能、整機驗收與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stage throughput, system acceptance and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
用機台時間戳記錄每一場的掃描、步進、整定與交換時間，與模型逐項比較找出產能損失來源。
一次出廠校正就能讓校正圖永久有效。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Log the scan, step, settle and exchange time of every field from machine timestamps and compare with the model item by item to locate throughput loss.
A single factory calibration keeps the calibration map valid forever.
quiz.explanation: 用機台時間戳記錄每一場的掃描、步進、整定與交換時間，與模型逐項比較找出產能損失來源；對同一片晶圓做兩次曝光量測套刻，取 |mean| + 3σ 與規格比較；核對交接文件中的校正圖版本與感測器校正日期是否與機台實際狀態一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log the scan, step, settle and exchange time of every field from machine timestamps and compare with the model item by item to locate throughput loss; expose the same wafer twice, measure overlay as |mean| + 3σ and compare with specification; check that the calibration-map versions and sensor calibration dates in the handoff record match the tool's actual state. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 載台產能、整機驗收與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stage throughput, system acceptance and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「產能模型與套刻驗收記錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Throughput model and overlay acceptance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了衝產能縮短整定時間，MA 看似仍在規格內，但 MSD 在每場起始端悄悄升高，CD 均勻性與良率在數週後才在電性測試中暴露，追查時已無當時的載台誤差紀錄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting settling time to chase throughput leaves MA apparently within specification while MSD creeps up at the start of every field; CD uniformity and yield only surface weeks later in electrical test, by which time the stage error logs of that period are gone. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收用同一片晶圓重複曝光量機台對自身套刻，用不同機台曝光量機台間套刻；交接文件包括校正圖版本、MA/MSD 基準曲線、熱穩定時間與所有感測器的校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance measures machine-to-itself overlay by re-exposing the same wafer and machine-to-machine overlay across tools; the handoff record includes calibration-map versions, MA/MSD baseline curves, thermal stabilisation time and the calibration dates of every sensor.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「套刻合格的機台，產能設定可以任意提高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A tool that passes overlay can have its throughput settings raised freely." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了衝產能縮短整定時間，MA 看似仍在規格內，但 MSD 在每場起始端悄悄升高，CD 均勻性與良率在數週後才在電性測試中暴露，追查時已無當時的載台誤差紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Cutting settling time to chase throughput leaves MA apparently within specification while MSD creeps up at the start of every field; CD uniformity and yield only surface weeks later in electrical test, by which time the stage error logs of that period are gone.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「載台產能、整機驗收與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stage throughput, system acceptance and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

為了衝產能縮短整定時間，MA 看似仍在規格內，但 MSD 在每場起始端悄悄升高，CD 均勻性與良率在數週後才在電性測試中暴露，追查時已無當時的載台誤差紀錄。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The static positioning accuracy of the stage equals the overlay accuracy.
Cutting settling time to chase throughput leaves MA apparently within specification while MSD creeps up at the start of every field.

quiz.explanationEn: Cutting settling time to chase throughput leaves MA apparently within specification while MSD creeps up at the start of every field; CD uniformity and yield only surface weeks later in electrical test, by which time the stage error logs of that period are gone.
